title: A clear job for each mode
problem: The Play menu lists modes without their purpose; the weekly Sprint ranking rewards playing every day; the League does not lead into the Daily or Sprint.
scope: Play menu: a Normal game group (Computer, One phone, rooms, Quick match), then League, Daily market and Sprint, each with its reason
Sprint weekly ranking counts each player's best 5 days; results show personal best, place and one decisive Rush moment
League to Sprint and Daily links; Daily twists that reuse combinations from finished chapters, chosen among existing twists and cards
exclusions: No rule change; the Daily keeps its full length and weekly twist

acceptance.text: npm run verify with capped-ranking tests
npm run test:e2e: Play menu groups and a Sprint with the weekly ranking
